llm_description: global_job表存储定时采集任务配置信息，用于管理设备数据采集频率、客户订单处理及告警触发规则，包含任务分组、执行类名和描述等关键业务参数。

columns.name: job_name
columns.description: 作业名称。常见值: interface_perf_job, interface_status_job, ip_sla_job, qos_job, slow_icmp_ping_job, web_site_job, atomic_circuit_job, common_job, device_basic_perf_job, discovery_job

columns.name: data_name
columns.description: 数据名称。常见值: icmp_ping_data, interface_perf_data, interface_status_data, ip_sla_data, qos_data, web_site_data, atomic_circuit_data, common_data, device_basic_perf_data, discovery_data

columns.name: job_class_name
columns.description: 作业实体类名称。常见值: com.ideal.netcare.v6.dcs.service.scheduler.job.InterfacePerfJob, com.ideal.netcare.v6.dcs.service.scheduler.job.InterfaceStatusJob, com.ideal.netcare.v6.dcs.service.scheduler.job.IPSLAJob, com.ideal.netcare.v6.dcs.service.scheduler.job.QoSJob, com.ideal.netcare.v6.dcs.service.scheduler.job.SlowIcmpPingJob, com.ideal.netcare.v6.dcs.service.scheduler.job.WebSiteJob, com.ideal.netcare.v6.dcs.service.scheduler.job.AtomicCircuitJob, com.ideal.netcare.v6.dcs.service.scheduler.job.CommonJob, com.ideal.netcare.v6.dcs.service.scheduler.job.DeviceBasicPerfJob, com.ideal.netcare.v6.dcs.service.scheduler.job.DiscoveryJob

embedding_text:
global_job表存储定时采集任务配置信息，用于管理设备数据采集频率、客户订单处理及告警触发规则，包含任务分组、执行类名和描述等关键业务参数。
表名: global_job
列信息: id(采集频率ID), collector_id(采集机ID), job_name(作业名称), job_group(作业分组), data_name(数据名称), cron_exp(频率时间), job_class_name(作业实体类名称), job_desc(作业描述), create_datetime(创建时间)
